description_en: Splendor Residence is an ambitious project located in the Porcelan area, just a few meters from the main road. The interior space of the residential complex creates micro green spaces, basketball half-courts, children's playgrounds, 2 green flower gardens and recreational spaces around them. We have for sale an apartment (2+1+2). The apartment has a total area of ​​114.55 m2, of which 93.26 m2 is a net interior area. It is organized in a large living room, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. Postparking with extra price Price: 1450 euro/m2 FOR A VISIT TO THE PROPERTY CONTACT ME
